|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition &lt; 6.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 26 December 2025: “Adds one battle destiny with Maul, Sidious, or Vader. Opponent's characters here are power and forfeit -1. Once per game, may take into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) (or retrieve into hand) Glancing Blow or Help Me Obi-Wan Kenobi. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition &lt; 6.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile]] (published 2 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi In Exile”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
